visual_review.notes: All clips from the first H3 takes; dense-guide retakes of attack and death came out as held stills with one-frame snaps. The idle snaps back to the neutral pose twice (video 59-60, 113-114); its two halves nearly repeat, so the loop runs forward through 0-58 and returns through 112 down to 62, and both joins match closely. The punch turns from the three-quarter wind-up to the side-on strike, as painted, in two smeared frames (video 30-31); they are cut, so the wind-up snaps into the punch. Death drops the two smeared falling frames (35-36) with green fringes, so the construct crashes down from standing. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
